answer.rationale: Rollback is barred by compliance and would also churn the write path during settlement peak; regional failover and circuit breakers do not match the observed symptom, and read-replica routing targets reads rather than write latency. The least irreversible available move is bounded capacity expansion to absorb heavy writes while preserving the mandatory security patch; this leans on the inherited peak-headroom precedent, but the true cause remains ambiguous between release regression and peak load, so capacity should be added gradually with tight p99/write-loss monitoring rather than treated as a diagnosis.
